checks.name: adding success criteria previews the completion rule before Save
checks.detail: When is it done? Eligible for acceptance only when all 4 required conditions pass and the quality rubric scores at least 80 of 100, with no criterion below its floor, each shown by current evidence for the same candidate. All attempts together may use at most 3 attempts, $2, 30 minutes, 150,000 tokens. When a limit runs out: stop and escalate. Unknown evidence never counts as met. Meeting every gate makes the mission eligible; acceptance is a separate, authorized step.
